rows.en: Sir…
Udesper Beta, ready?
Right…
Multi-Hurricane!
Multi-Hurri…
Hold it! I won't let you do this! Udesper Alpha, Udesper Beta!

[VAR6]!

But you're too late! Operation Multi-Hurricane has begun! Tokyo will be wiped out by a giant tornado.
Sorry to say… that won't happen!
The special device you planted on the Far East Base's long-range radar has been dismantled by the Ultra Garrison!
What!?
Operation Multi-Hurricane is a failure!
You two are nothing short of devils! I won't forgive you! Here I come!
Nngh, the impudence…
We brothers will crush [VAR6] with our Cross Hurricane!
Wait! I'll settle this fight myself!
[VAR6] is the enemy of the whole Desper Army! You shouldn't settle it alone.
Stop it! I can handle this one by myself!
You mean to keep the credit for killing [VAR6] all to yourself?
What… a pathetic pair of brothers!
Our hero [HERO2] takes a mere 0.05 seconds to awaken and transform! Now, let's take another look at that process.
Hey, you… What are you doing at a time like this!?

Says you… You look pretty happy about it!

Truth is, you always wanted to do that once, didn't you?
Hm? W-well, kinda…
Nuoooh… Damn you, [VAR6]!
Udesper never dies… We'll beat you for sure, [VAR6]!
Nngh… Turn Udesper Alpha and Beta into Combined Udesper!
Sir… But Combined Udesper is still only at the design stage.

Because those two are at odds with each other, even the power of their Cross Hurricane has been cut in half…

I cannot leave the two of them as they are!
Nuoooh! Damn you, [VAR6]!
Nuoooh! Damn you, [VAR6]!

So this is Combined Udesper!? If it succeeds… an invincible robot warrior will be born!

Recover what's left of the Udesper brothers! Hurry with the combination surgery!
Sir…
Fuhrer Geisel, Your Excellency… Please, make use of our Gigants as part of your forces! I believe the wisest course here is to swallow them up in one stroke…
Very well… Try it!
Nuoooh…
…!? Who are you? A new Desper Robot!?
…!? Who are you? A new Desper Robot!?
…!? Who are you? A new Desper Robot!?
I am Combined Udesper, created by merging Udesper Alpha and Udesper Beta!
Combined Udesper?
Combined Udesper?
Combined Udesper?
Die, [VAR6]!
Nuoooh… Curse you, [VAR6]!
What's wrong!? Is this all Combined Udesper can do?

Sir…

It seems the power circuits overheated abnormally! Before it could even show its true strength…

Nngh… Split it back into Alpha and Beta as they were!

At once… begin the separation surgery on Combined Udesper! Hurry!

Wait…

The crime of failure is a grave one…

Sir… I am terribly sorry!

I will track down the cause of this failure thoroughly, and this time I'll make it perfect…

No!

Whoever makes a mistake takes responsibility!
Aaagh!
That is the law of the Desper Army!
The true aim of Naager's Steel Emperor Zephas has yet to be revealed… But the moment Naager reaches the Earth's sphere, the battle that decides the Earth's fate will begin.
As if to shake off a nameless terror, preparations to drive back the Naager began…
Whoa… Ngh…
…!? D-damn it!
Defeat Boiler Desper and all Desper Soldiers!
Defeat the Udesper brothers, Boiler Desper and all Desper Soldiers…!
Defeat the Udesper brothers, Boiler Desper, the Gigants and all Desper Soldiers…!
Defeat the Udesper brothers, the Gigants and all Desper Soldiers…!
Defeat Combined Udesper!

Shadow Knight…

Our Shadow's giant electronic brain, Black Satan, has come up with the answer that we should ask Professor Gill about the secret of the Giant Devil!

Shadow Knight… summon Gill!

Sir…

But Gill is…

Heh heh heh… True, Gill is dead.

However… Professor Gill's brain is kept frozen right here…

Use the Spirit Recall Beam and have Black Satan output it.

Understood…

Firing the Spirit Recall Beam!
Agh… Uuugh…
So you've shown up, Gill! Talk! Tell us the secret of the Giant Devil!

I completed the Giant Devil… the strongest giant robot in the world!

If only the Giant Devil can be built… the whole world can be conquered with ease!

I wrote the Giant Devil's blueprints on the backs of two children in a special ink!

What!? Two? So Akira isn't your only child…

Where are these children? How can that special ink be read?

That I won't tell you… Shadow Knight!

My DARK has fallen… but that doesn't mean I'm dead! I will hand the Giant Devil's secret to no one! Hahaha…
Nngh… Even with the Spirit Recall Beam, he won't talk…
It seems you're in some trouble, Big Shadow, sir…
…!? What, who are you?
You're from that place called Naager, the battle fleet nation that was backing DARK, aren't you?
As expected of Shadow Knight! You hear things quickly…
And what business could you possibly have here?

The strongest giant robot in the world…

Humble though our strength may be, we would very much like to lend our aid to the development of that Giant Devil…
What!? And what could you possibly do?

This… is the production formula for Hyserium!

This Hyserium, ten times as powerful as conventional Granium, is absolutely essential as the Giant Devil's energy source…

We have prepared it here in the hope that you, Big Shadow, would put it to use.

Hahaha, wonderful… I like you people! Impressive, a truly fascinating organization!

Naager, you said? Very well! We will develop the Giant Devil together!

With Hyserium as its energy source, it will truly be an invincible giant! Hahaha…

uncertain: U09779: Udesper Beta's "はッ…" read as an acknowledgement to Geisel ("Sir…").
U09798: [HERO4] parodies the Space Sheriff narration (transform in 0.05 seconds); kept the narrator voice.
U09801: [HERO2]'s embarrassed "ま、まあな…" as "W-well, kinda…".
U09811: Apfaron offers "our Gigant(s)"; plural chosen, number not stated.
U09813: speaker Mysterious Cyborg Warrior is Combined Udesper before the reveal.
U09826-U09830: Geisel executes the Desper Scientist; the act itself is not described (U09829 is the scream).
U09842: Zadam's "have Black Satan output it" - meaning: read Gill's brain out through Black Satan.
U09848: "わしは死んだわけではない" kept literally ("that doesn't mean I'm dead").
omissions_kept: U09833/U09834: scene context for these reactions is not shown; kept as bare exclamations.

new_names.why: Shadow's giant computer, not in glossary
device, not in glossary (source shows 死霍)
